ELASTIC_CLOUD_ID.description: Identifies the deployment and saves the client a URL. Elastic states no sensitivity, and unlike Meilisearch and Typesense it publishes no key built for a browser, so nothing here is treated as public. The name is convention.

ELASTIC_API_KEY.description: Created in your deployment's Kibana and carried as base64 of an id and a key joined by a colon. Elastic states no sensitivity; its permissions are whatever role you gave it, so it is treated as secret. The name is convention.
